title: Concept: Go dependency on a pre-1.0 module
description: go.mod declares a `v0.x` module version, which carries no compatibility promise, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The API can change in any release, so the build can break or silently change behaviour without a major-version signal.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through go.mod (go).
risk: The API can change in any release, so the build can break or silently change behaviour without a major-version signal.
